findings.title: Invalid timestamp crashes version display
findings.why_it_matters: A syntactically valid metadata object with an invalid builtAt string reaches Intl.DateTimeFormat and throws when the version page renders.
evidence: parseBuildInfo previously accepted every string for builtAt while VersionSettingsPage passes it directly to formatDate.

findings.title: Direct pushes bypass version comparison
findings.why_it_matters: The workflow runs on main pushes but previously supplied a base SHA only for pull_request events, so direct runtime changes could retain the current product version.
evidence: ZOS_VERSION_BASE previously resolved only github.event.pull_request.base.sha even though the workflow also triggers on pushes to main.

findings.title: Version policy permits downgrades
findings.why_it_matters: A manually synchronized lower version differed from the base and therefore passed the prior check, allowing release history to move backward.
evidence: The prior policy rejected only equality between baseManifest.version and state.version and did not compare their SemVer order.

appliedFixes: Validate build timestamps at the API boundary.
Use github.event.before as the comparison base for direct branch pushes.
Reject product version downgrades with stable SemVer ordering.

residualRisks: Interrupted multi-file release preparation can leave recoverable tracked-file drift; version:check detects it before another release.

verification: desktop and 390px mobile browser checks in English and Simplified Chinese
